text: dsh-voice-alert 是面向 DSH 网页和桌面客户端的会话提醒插件。它在会话显示完成或出现待回复问题、计划审核、授权请求时播放不同提示音，并在设置页提供音量、音色、自定义音频和独立开关。用户也可选择发送系统通知、设置通知正文并测试投递；完成提醒支持防抖，避免短暂停顿误报。适合希望不盯着会话列表也能及时知道任务结束或需要处理的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-voice-alert plays separate sounds when DSH sessions finish or need a reply. Its Settings page controls volume, tones, custom audio, and optional system notifications. Users can set notification text and test delivery. No API key or external account is needed.
想让 DSH 任务结束时自动播放提示音。
DSH 正在等我回答或批准时，能不能用声音提醒？
我想给会话完成和待回复分别选提示音并调节音量。
希望后台窗口也能弹出任务完成或待处理的系统通知。
Can I get a sound when a DSH session finishes?
I want desktop notifications when DSH is waiting for my answer.
dsh-voice-alert 的功能「完成提示音」：顶层会话完成时播放所选音色或自定义音频；可设置总音量、单独开关及防抖时长。
dsh-voice-alert 的功能「待回复提醒」：会话出现问题、计划审核或授权请求时播放独立提示音，且同一待处理事项只提醒一次。
dsh-voice-alert 的功能「系统通知」：可为完成和待回复事件分别启用通知、配置正文，并限制为窗口位于后台时发送。
dsh-voice-alert 的功能「提醒设置页」：在 DSH 设置中试听和选择内置音色、上传不超过 1.5 MB 的自定义音频，并保存偏好。
dsh-voice-alert 的提示音依赖浏览器音频能力，页面需先收到一次用户操作才能解锁音频；自定义音频最大 1.5 MB，并以 data URL 保存。
dsh-voice-alert 的系统通知默认关闭，需在设置页启用并由操作系统或浏览器授予通知权限；没有可读会话状态服务时相应提醒会降级。
想在会话等待我批准计划或回答问题时收到声音提示。
想给 DSH 提醒设置自定义铃声，并能在设置页试听。

dsh-voice-alert README · dsh-voice-alert：[](https://github.com/BUGLAN/dsh-voice-alert/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin: it plays one
sound when a session shows as finished in the sidebar, plays another when the sidebar shows
that dsh needs you to answer or choose, can raise a Windows/macOS system notification for
either moment, and adds a **Sound alerts** (语音提醒) page to Settings where all of it is
configured.

[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：Both alerts copy the sidebar's own status dots: the plugin derives each session row's dot
from the same inputs the sidebar uses, so a sound means what the dot means.

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：| Alert | Trigger | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Completion sound (`chime-up`) | a top-level session row shows the green dot: nothing is pending, the session is not running, no direct child is running, and its turn has ended | on |
| Reply-needed sound (`ask-up`) | a top-level session row shows the yellow dot: a question, a plan review, or an approval is waiting for you | on |
| System notification | the same two moments, as a Windows/macOS notification | off (opt-in) |

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：A row can only show a dot if the sidebar draws it at all. A session this browser has no
catalog row for — a teammate whose catalog was loaded by another window — is unknown, and an
unknown row alerts for nothing. Nor does a session that is a subagent or carries a parent, an
archived session, or a blank New Session row.

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：The green dot is not "the turn ended", it is "the work stopped": a turn that starts again
inside `completionDelayMs` (default 1200 ms) cancels its own alert, and a session that still
has a direct child running keeps showing the spinning dot instead of the green one, so a
parent that stops while its teammate works stays silent until the last child stops. That
last child stopping is what turns the row green, and it alerts exactly once.

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：One finished turn alerts once. The turn's own number is its identity, so re-reaching the same
finished state — a repeated snapshot, or a running flag that blips while the session list
catches up with the status stream — never raises the alert again; only a turn the log has
actually advanced to does. When the turn cannot be named because the view had already retired
the window, the stop that raised the alert carries the credit instead, so opening that session
afterwards does not report the same stop a second time.

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：The turn's own log says why it ended (`turn/end` carries a reason): `completed`, `blocked`
and `max-tokens` alert; `aborted` (the user, a parent agent, a hook or disposal),
`interrupted` and `forked` stay silent. That log only ever refines an alert the status
signal already raised — it never raises one by itself, because opening a session for the
first time materializes its log, and the last turn of that log may have ended long before
this page existed. Leaving a session retires this browser's event window for it, so a
background session has none: the sidebar's own unread mark (its green dot) still alerts, and
only the window-backed refinements — the reason, the failure text, and the latest prompt —
fall back to their defaults.

dsh-voice-alert README · What it does：The two signals are held to different standards, because only one of them already means
"finished". The sidebar's unread mark is that dot, so it alerts by itself. This browser's own
running-true→false observation is not: the session may have finished, or you may have stopped
it, and only the durable log tells the two apart. So that edge alerts when a readable window
proves the newest turn ended (`completed`, `blocked`, `max-tokens`) and stays silent when the
turn was cancelled, still open, or unreadable. A session you stop and leave is the case that
proves it: the view retires the window while the stop settles, and an idle edge with nothing
left to prove it is not a finish.

dsh-voice-alert README · What a toast says：The title is always that session's `displayTitle` and carries no icon. The body opens with a
status icon, then the work's name: it is the newest prompt the user themselves sent in that
session, collapsed to one line and bounded to 120 characters, so a completion reads as the
thing you asked for rather than as the session's auto-generated title. A user-role message is
not always a prompt — injected context (workspace instructions, skill catalogs, teammate
framing) arrives in the user role too — so only `source.kind === 'user'` counts.

dsh-voice-alert README · What a toast says：| Icon | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `🐳` | the completion alert for a turn that ended normally |
| `🌀` | the completion alert for a turn that ended in an error |
| `❗` | the reply-needed alert (a question, plan review, or approval is waiting) |

dsh-voice-alert README · What a toast says：The icon always leads the body, whatever the body turns out to be — your explicit text
override, the failure message, the latest prompt, or the built-in copy — because it names the
event rather than the text. Body precedence per alert is unchanged: your explicit text
override, then (for a turn that ended in an error) the failure message, then the latest
prompt, then the built-in copy. The session title never becomes the body. The settings page's
**Send a test notification** button is not an alert, so its body has no icon — it does use
the completion sound, so the probe checks audio and notification in one press.

dsh-voice-alert README · What a toast says：**An error is not a third alert.** It has no title, switch or tone of its own: a failed turn
raises the completion alert with the completion sound and the completion switch, and the
error message only supplies the body — its icon is `🌀` instead of `🐳`. The error title and
body entries the settings dictionary used to carry are gone.

dsh-voice-alert README · Requirements：- **DeepSeek Harness** — a build whose client exposes `uiSession.sessionStatus` and the
  `settings.section` slot (the 0.1.7 line and newer).
- **Node.js** 22.19+ or 24+ for the dsh process that loads the Host half.
- **Runtime** — the desktop app or the web UI. Sounds play in the page, so the page needs a
  user gesture at least once — an alert raised before that plays when audio unlocks;
  notifications use the renderer's `Notification` API, which the
  desktop shell routes to the OS notification center.

dsh-voice-alert README · System notifications on macOS：The notification switch and the sound switches are independent, and the notification one is
off by default **per machine**: with only the sounds on, macOS plays a tone and never raises a
banner — which is usually the whole difference from a Windows machine where the toggle was
turned on. To diagnose:

dsh-voice-alert README · System notifications on macOS：1. Turn on **Enable system notifications** in Settings and press **Send a test notification**.
   The page then reports the receipt: the system accepted it, or it got no receipt.
2. On "no receipt", check **System Settings → Notifications → DeepSeek Harness**: allow
   notifications, set the style to Banners, and make sure Focus is not silencing them.
3. macOS only asks for authorization when this app posts its first notification, and it drops
   that very notification. The plugin re-sends that first delivery once; if the first test
   still shows nothing, press it again after allowing the system prompt.
4. Clearing **Only while the window is not in front** makes alerts fire while the app is
   frontmost too — but macOS tends to file a frontmost app's notifications straight into
   Notification Center, so put the window behind another app while testing.

dsh-voice-alert README · Install：A DSH profile installs plugins as **bundles**, and this package is one: it ships
`cordis.patch.yml` and declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so a profile only has to depend on it.

**Through dsh (recommended).** Ask the agent to install the bundle, or call the plugin
manager tool directly:

```jsonc
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "github:BUGLAN/dsh-voice-alert" }
```

dsh-voice-alert README · Install：A git spec is fetched with git, so the machine needs network access to github.com. The
install adds `dsh-voice-alert` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, records the dependency
in the profile's `package.json`, and links it into the profile's `node_modules`. There is no
build step — `lib/` ships in the repository.

**By hand.** In `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>`:

```sh
pnpm add github:BUGLAN/dsh-voice-alert
```

dsh-voice-alert README · Install：then add `"dsh-voice-alert"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` and
start dsh.

dsh-voice-alert README · Settings page：The OS sound of a notification is suppressed whenever this plugin already played its own
sound for that event, so you never hear two alerts; with the plugin's sound off, the
notification keeps the OS sound.

dsh-voice-alert README · Configuration：| Key | Type and default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean, `true` | master switch for both sounds |
| `volume` | number 0–1, `0.6` | playback volume, as a fraction of full scale |
| `completionEnabled` | boolean, `true` | play a sound when a session row shows the green dot |
| `completionTone` | string, `chime-up` | built-in tone used when no custom file is set |
| `completionFile` | string, `''` | custom completion sound, as a data URL |
| `completionDelayMs` | number 0–60000, `1200` | debounce before the completion alert; `0` disables it |
| `waitingEnabled` | boolean, `true` | play a sound when a reply is needed |
| `waitingTone` | string, `ask-up` | built-in tone used when no custom file is set |
| `waitingFile` | string, `''` | custom reply-needed sound, as a data URL |
| `notifyEnabled` | boolean, `false` | raise a system notification in addition to the sound |
| `notifyCompletion` | boolean, `true` | notify when a session row shows the green dot |
| `notifyWaiting` | boolean, `true` | notify when a reply is needed |
| `notifyBackgroundOnly` | boolean, `true` | notify only while the window is not in front |
| `notifyComple

dsh-voice-alert README · Configuration：The 8 built-in tones: `chime-up` (bright rise), `chime-down` (soft fall), `bell`, `ping`,
`double`, `triple`, `ask-up` (light rise), `ask-down` (light fall). `completionFile` and
`waitingFile` are written by the Settings page's file picker; setting one by hand means
pasting the whole data URL.

dsh-voice-alert README · Where a value comes from：A profile without a settings provider still works: layer 4 is inactive, the page's writes are
browser-local (durable across reloads and app restarts, per browser), and the page says so.
Adding a settings provider needs no change here — the Host half already registers the
namespace, and the scope then outranks the mirror automatically.

dsh-voice-alert README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test        # node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/host.mjs
```

dsh-voice-alert README · Development：`tests/smoke.mjs` runs `lib/client.js` under stubbed browser globals and a stubbed Cordis
context, then drives the session-status and session-list observables: the Settings section
registers, controls write, both sidebar-dot alerts fire, and the no-alert cases stay silent —
including a subagent or teammate that finishes, a session with no catalog row, a parent
whose child still runs, a cancelled turn, and a stop whose event window the view has already
retired. `tests/host.mjs` runs `lib/index.js` against a stubbed Host context: the settings
namespace registers and the entry Config reaches the page. No browser, no keys, no build; CI
runs both on Linux, Windows and macOS.

dsh-voice-alert README · Layout：```
package.json          package name, ./client export, dsh.client + dsh.bundle.patch
cordis.patch.yml      the bundle layer: inserts row `voice-alert` naming this package
lib/index.js          Host half: settings namespace + page injection of the Config
lib/client.js         Browser half: loader bundle — sounds, Settings section, triggers

dsh-voice-alert README · Layout：The browser half is authored directly in the bundle format the client module system serves
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) and requests only baseline module-table
entries (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`), so this package needs no build step.

dsh-voice-alert README · Layout：`inject` is deliberately `['slots', 'locale']`. Everything else is read through `ctx.get(...)`:
a plugin that never receives an optional service stays active with a degraded feature, while
declaring one this composition lacks would hold the whole plugin — Settings page included —
pending forever.

dsh-voice-alert README · Layout：**After editing the code:** `lib/client.js` — toggle the row off and on (`set_plugin` twice);
the re-scan gives the artifact a new revision and the browser fetches the fresh bundle.
`lib/index.js` — the Host module stays in Node's module cache, so the change lands on the
next start of dsh.

dsh-voice-alert README · Notes and limits：- The Host half imports `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, the package's only dependency. A profile
  that links this checkout by path instead of fetching it needs that module resolvable from
  here.
- Sound plays in the browser page, so the page must have received a user gesture at least
  once (the ordinary browser autoplay rule). A pre-gesture `AudioContext` is resumed on the
  next gesture, and an alert raised while it was suspended plays then instead of being lost
  to the frozen timeline.
- Notification permission: the DeepSeek Harness desktop shell grants non-media permissions
  from the owned window, so the switch works without a prompt there. In a plain browser the
  first enable or the test button triggers the browser prompt, and a denial is shown in the
  block.
- A notification is raised only when the window is not in front by default, so an active user
  is not interrupted by a toast about the thing already on screen.
- Every open page of the profile alerts; the trigger is per profile, not per window.
- The dot the plugin reads is the sidebar's own derivation, copied into the plugin: the
  plugin never changes what the sidebar shows.

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：会话在侧边栏显示
为已完成时播放一种提示音，侧边栏显示 dsh 需要你回答或选择时播放另一种，两者都可以额外弹出
Windows / macOS 系统通知，并在设置里新增一个「语音提醒」页面统一配置。

[English →](README.md)

dsh-voice-alert README · 功能：两种提醒都抄写侧边栏自己的状态点：插件用与侧边栏相同的输入推导每一行的状态点，所以响声的含义
就是状态点的含义。

| 提醒 | 触发时机 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| 完成提示音（`chime-up`） | 某个顶层会话行出现绿色状态点：没有待处理交互、会话自身未在运行、没有正在运行的直接子会话，且该会话的回合已结束 | 开 |
| 需要你回复提示音（`ask-up`） | 某个顶层会话行出现黄色状态点：有待回答的问题、待确认的计划或待授权 | 开 |
| 系统通知 | 上面两个时刻，弹 Windows / macOS 通知 | 关（需手动开启） |

只有侧边栏真的会画出来的行才可能有状态点。本浏览器没有该会话目录行的（例如目录由别的窗口加载
的 teammate）就是「未知」，未知行不会触发任何提醒；子代理会话或带 `parentId` 的会话同样不会，
归档行与空白行也不会。

dsh-voice-alert README · 功能：绿点不等于「回合结束了」，而是「活停了」：在 `completionDelayMs`（默认 1200 ms）内又开始的回合会
取消自己的提醒；还有直接子会话在运行的会话，侧边栏显示的是转圈而不是绿点，所以父会话停下而
teammate 还在跑时保持安静，直到最后一个子会话停下 —— 那一刻该行才变绿，并且只提醒一次。

一轮结束只提醒一次。这一轮的编号就是它的身份：重复到达同一个已结束状态 —— 同一份快照反复发布，
或者会话列表还没跟上状态流、running 抖了一下 —— 都不会再次提醒，只有日志真正推进到下一轮才会。
窗口已经被视图释放、这一轮无法命名时，就由触发提醒的那次停止来记这笔账：之后再把该会话打开，
也不会为同一次停止重复提醒。

dsh-voice-alert README · 功能：回合的持久化日志记录了它为什么结束（`turn/end` 带有结束原因）：`completed`、`blocked`、
`max-tokens` 会提醒；`aborted`（用户、父 agent、hook 或销毁）、`interrupted`、`forked` 保持安静。
这份日志只用来细化状态信号已经给出的提醒，**它自己不会触发提醒** —— 第一次点开一个会话会把它的日志
物化出来，而日志里最新一轮可能早在本页面存在之前就结束了。离开一个会话会释放本浏览器持有的该会话
事件窗口，所以后台会话根本没有窗口：提醒照样由侧边栏自己的未读标记（绿点）触发，只有依赖窗口的细节
—— 结束原因、失败信息、最新 prompt —— 退回到各自的默认值。

dsh-voice-alert README · 功能：两个信号的标准并不相同，因为只有其中一个本身就代表「已完成」。侧边栏的未读标记就是那个绿点，单凭它
就能提醒。本浏览器自己观察到的 running 由真变假不是：这一轮可能是正常结束，也可能是你按了停止，只有
持久化日志能把两者分开。所以这个边沿只有在可读的窗口证明最新一轮确实结束（`completed`、`blocked`、
`max-tokens`）时才提醒；这一轮被取消、仍在运行、或窗口已经读不到时都保持安静。你停掉一个会话然后离开
正是这种情况：停止还在收尾，视图已经把事件窗口释放掉了，而此时没有任何证据的 idle 边沿并不等于完成。

dsh-voice-alert README · 什么时候不提醒：- 你按了停止 / 取消了这一轮（`aborted`，原因为 `user` 或 `parent`）；
- 停下的那一刻本浏览器已经读不到它的回合：既没有可读的结束原因，又没有侧边栏的未读标记时，idle 边沿
  与正常结束同样可能，因此不提醒；
- 这一轮由崩溃修复或 fork 标记收尾（`interrupted`、`forked`）；
- 该行属于内部运行：子 agent 或 teammate 会话（`origin: 'subagent'`，或任何带 `parentId` 的
  会话），它们的结束在日常工作中非常频繁 —— 本浏览器根本没有它的目录行时同样不提醒；
- 该行还有直接子会话在运行（侧边栏显示的是转圈，不是绿点）；
- 在防抖时间内这一轮又继续了；
- 对应的开关是关的、总开关是关的，或者开着 `notifyBackgroundOnly` 而窗口就在最前面。

dsh-voice-alert README · 通知的标题与正文：标题永远是该会话的 `displayTitle`，不带任何图标。正文以状态图标开头，后面才是「哪件事」：取该
会话里**你自己发出的最新一条 prompt**，压成一行并限制在 120 字以内。所以完成通知读起来是你要的
那件事，而不是会话自动生成的标题。user 角色的消息不一定是 prompt —— 注入的上下文（工作区说明、
技能目录、teammate 框架文本）也是 user 角色 —— 因此只认 `source.kind === 'user'`。

| 图标 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `🐳` | 完成提醒，且这一轮正常结束 |
| `🌀` | 完成提醒，且这一轮以错误结束 |
| `❗` | 需要你回复的提醒（有待回答的问题、待确认的计划或待授权） |

dsh-voice-alert README · 通知的标题与正文：图标**始终在正文最前**，无论正文最终来自哪里 —— 你显式填写的覆盖文本、失败信息、最新 prompt，还是
内置文案 —— 因为它表示的是「哪一类事件」，而不是正文内容。每个提醒的正文优先级不变：你显式填写的
覆盖文本 →（以错误结束的那一轮）失败信息 → 最新 prompt → 内置文案。会话标题永远不会成为正文。
设置页的 **发送测试通知** 按钮不是提醒，所以它的正文没有图标 —— 但它会使用完成提示音，一次点击
即可同时自检声音和通知。

**出错不是第三个提醒。** 它没有自己的标题、开关或音色：出错的那一轮照常走完成提醒，用完成音色和
完成开关，错误信息只作为正文来源 —— 只是图标从 `🐳` 换成 `🌀`。字典里原来的错误标题与错误正文两条
文案已删除。

dsh-voice-alert README · 环境要求：- **DeepSeek Harness** —— 客户端需提供 `uiSession.sessionStatus` 与 `settings.section` 插槽
  （0.1.7 及以后）。
- **Node.js** 22.19+ 或 24+（dsh 进程加载 Host 部分）。
- **运行环境** —— 桌面端或网页端。提示音在页面里播放，因此页面至少需要一次用户操作（之前的提醒会在解锁后补播）；通知使用
  渲染进程的 `Notification` API，桌面端会把它转成系统通知中心的通知。

dsh-voice-alert README · macOS 上的系统通知：系统通知和提示音是**两个独立开关**，而且通知开关是按机器开启的（默认关闭）：只打开提示音时，
macOS 上就只会听到声音、不会弹横幅 —— 这与 Windows 上看起来「正常」的区别通常就在这里。排查顺序：

1. 设置页打开 **启用系统通知**，再点 **发送测试通知**。设置页会显示这条通知的回执：系统接收了，
   还是「系统没有回执」。
2. 没有回执时检查 **系统设置 → 通知 → DeepSeek Harness**：允许通知、样式设为「横幅」，并确认没有
   开着「专注模式」。
3. macOS 是在本应用发出第一条通知时才向系统申请授权的，而它会把正在申请授权的那一条丢掉。插件已为
   这第一次投递补发一次；若第一次测试仍无横幅，等授权弹窗点过「允许」后再测一次。
4. 关掉 **仅当窗口不在最前时通知** 会让提醒在应用位于前台时也发出；但 macOS 常把前台应用的通知直接
   收进通知中心而不弹横幅，测试时可以让窗口退到后面。

dsh-voice-alert README · 安装：DSH 的 profile 以 **bundle** 形式安装插件，本包就是一个 bundle：自带 `cordis.patch.yml` 并声明了
`dsh.bundle.patch`，所以 profile 只需要依赖它。

**通过 dsh 安装（推荐）。** 直接让 agent 安装这个 bundle，或自己调用插件管理工具：

```jsonc
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "github:BUGLAN/dsh-voice-alert" }
```

git 形式的地址会用 git 拉取，所以机器需要能访问 github.com。安装会把 `dsh-voice-alert` 加入该
profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，把依赖写进 profile 的 `package.json`，并链接进 profile 的
`node_modules`。不需要构建：`lib/` 直接随仓库发布。

**手动安装。** 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>` 下执行：

dsh-voice-alert README · 安装：```sh
pnpm add github:BUGLAN/dsh-voice-alert
```

然后把 `"dsh-voice-alert"` 加入该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，再启动 dsh。

dsh-voice-alert README · 设置页面：设置 → **语音提醒**（order 60，排在 Agent presets 之后）：

- 提示音总开关和音量滑块；
- 每个声音一个分组 —— 任务结束、需要你回复 —— 各自带独立开关；
- 内置音色选择（8 种；选中即保存并试听）以及 **试听** 按钮；
- 可选的自定义音频（≤ 1.5 MB），以 data URL 保存，**清除** 可回到内置音色；
- **系统通知** 分组：自己的开关、每个事件一个开关、「仅当窗口不在最前时通知」开关、每个事件可
  覆盖通知正文、当前权限状态，以及 **发送测试通知** 按钮（申请权限、播放完成提示音，并真的弹
  一条通知，方便你听效果、看效果和摆放位置）。

当本插件已经为同一个事件播放过提示音时，系统通知会静音，所以不会听到两声；插件提示音关掉时，
通知保留系统提示音。

dsh-voice-alert README · 配置项：每个偏好都是本插件 entry 的 Config 字段，因此既能在设置页面里改，也能写在 profile 的
`cordis.yml` / `cordis.patch.yml`（或 Plugins 页面的配置编辑器）里：

dsh-voice-alert README · 配置项：| 键 | 类型与默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean，`true` | 两个提示音的总开关 |
| `volume` | number 0–1，`0.6` | 音量（满量程的比例） |
| `completionEnabled` | boolean，`true` | 会话行显示绿色状态点时播放提示音 |
| `completionTone` | string，`chime-up` | 未设置自定义音频时使用的内置音色 |
| `completionFile` | string，`''` | 自定义完成提示音，data URL |
| `completionDelayMs` | number 0–60000，`1200` | 完成提醒的防抖时长；`0` 关闭防抖 |
| `waitingEnabled` | boolean，`true` | 需要你回复时播放提示音 |
| `waitingTone` | string，`ask-up` | 未设置自定义音频时使用的内置音色 |
| `waitingFile` | string，`''` | 自定义回复提示音，data URL |
| `notifyEnabled` | boolean，`false` | 在提示音之外再弹系统通知 |
| `notifyCompletion` | boolean，`true` | 会话行显示绿色状态点时通知 |
| `notifyWaiting` | boolean，`true` | 需要你回复时通知 |
| `notifyBackgroundOnly` | boolean，`true` | 仅当窗口不在最前时通知 |
| `notifyCompletionBody` | string，`''` | 完成通知正文；留空用内置文案（两种情况下状态图标都会自动加在最前） |
| `notifyWaitingBody` | string，`''` | 回复通知正文；留空用内置文案（两种情况下状态图标都会自动加在最前） |

dsh-voice-alert README · 配置项：8 种内置音色：`chime-up`（清脆上行）、`chime-down`（柔和下行）、`bell`（铃音）、`ping`（单声
提示）、`double`（双声提示）、`triple`（三连音）、`ask-up`（轻快上行）、`ask-down`（轻快下行）。
`completionFile` 与 `waitingFile` 由设置页面的文件选择器写入；手写就要粘贴完整的 data URL。

dsh-voice-alert README · 配置从哪一层来：偏好按层读取，后面的覆盖前面的：

1. 浏览器部分里的内置默认值；
2. 本 entry 的 Config，以 `window.__DSH_VOICE_ALERT__` 注入页面 —— 所以
   `cordis.patch.yml` 的值或 Plugins 页面的配置编辑器会生效；
3. 浏览器的 `localStorage` 镜像，也就是设置页面写入的值；
4. profile 组合了设置提供者时，持久化的 Host 设置命名空间 `voice-alert`。

没有设置提供者的 profile 也能用：第 4 层不生效，设置页面的写入只存在于浏览器本地（跨刷新和重启
有效，按浏览器区分），页面会提示这一点。以后加入设置提供者无需改动本插件 —— Host 部分已经注册了
该命名空间，届时设置作用域会自动优先于镜像。

dsh-voice-alert README · 开发：```sh
npm install
npm test        # node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/host.mjs
```

`tests/smoke.mjs` 在桩化的浏览器全局对象与桩化的 Cordis 上下文里运行 `lib/client.js`，然后驱动
会话状态与会话列表 observable：设置分组注册成功、控件能写入、两个按侧边栏状态点的提醒都会响、不该
响的情况保持安静 —— 包括子 agent 或 teammate 结束、没有目录行的会话、还有子会话在跑的父会话、
被取消的一轮，以及视图已经把事件窗口释放掉的停止。`tests/host.mjs` 在桩化的 Host 上下文里运行
`lib/index.js`：命名空间注册成功、entry Config 能到达页面。不需要浏览器、不需要密钥、不需要构建；
CI 会在 Linux、Windows、macOS 上分别跑一遍。

dsh-voice-alert README · 目录结构：```
package.json         包名、./client 导出、dsh.client + dsh.bundle.patch
cordis.patch.yml     bundle 层：插入名为 dsh-voice-alert 的 `voice-alert` 行
lib/index.js         Host 部分：设置命名空间 + 把 Config 注入页面
lib/client.js        浏览器部分：loader bundle —— 声音、设置分组、触发逻辑

浏览器部分直接按客户端模块系统所提供的 bundle 格式编写
（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`），并且只请求模块表里的基础模块（`react`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`），所以本包不需要构建步骤。

dsh-voice-alert README · 目录结构：`inject` 特意只声明了 `['slots', 'locale']`。其余服务都通过 `ctx.get(...)` 读取：没拿到可选服务的
插件仍保持 active、只是功能降级；而把它声明成依赖，一旦这套组合里没有该服务，整个插件 —— 包括设置
页面 —— 就会一直处于 pending。

**改完代码之后：** `lib/client.js` —— 把该行关掉再打开（`set_plugin` 两次），重新扫描会给产物一个新
版本，浏览器会重新拉取；`lib/index.js` —— Host 模块留在 Node 的模块缓存里，所以要下次启动 dsh
才生效。

dsh-voice-alert README · 说明与限制：- Host 部分 import 了 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，这是本包唯一的依赖。如果 profile 是以路径
  link 本目录（而不是拉取）的方式安装，就需要该模块在这里可解析。
- 提示音在浏览器页面里播放，所以页面至少要收到过一次用户操作（浏览器的自动播放规则）。在用户操作
  之前创建的 `AudioContext` 会在下一次操作时被恢复，此前触发的提醒会在恢复后立即补播，而不是丢失。
- 通知权限：DeepSeek Harness 桌面端会为自有窗口授予非媒体权限，所以在桌面端这个开关不需要弹窗。
  在普通浏览器里，第一次开启或点测试按钮会触发浏览器授权弹窗，被拒绝时页面会显示提示。
- 默认只在窗口不在最前时弹通知，免得打断正在看屏幕的你。
- 该 profile 下每个打开的页面都会提醒；触发是按 profile 的，不是按窗口的。
- 插件读的状态点就是侧边栏自己的推导，只是抄进插件里：插件不会改变侧边栏的显示。由此有两处刻意的
  差异：正在看的会话只有在可读窗口能证明这一轮确实结束时才照响（侧边栏会清掉你正在读的那个会话自己
  的完成提醒），以及被取消的一轮保持安静（侧边栏此时仍可能显示绿点）。
- 自定义音频整个存在设置值里，请控制在通知长度的片段内；过大的文件会被拒绝并给出提示。
- 内置音色是 Web Audio 振荡器生成的，不会从网络拉取任何东西。
- 完成提醒的防抖是 Config 字段（`completionDelayMs`，默认 1200 ms，`0` 关闭）。它不在设置页面上
  渲染；如果某个工作流每轮之间的停顿经常超过一秒，就在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里设置它。
